[[File:NarShaddaaSwoopTrack-KotOR2.jpg|thumb|300px|Nar Shaddaa swoop racing.]]
The '''Nar Shaddaa swoop track''' was a course developed from [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] old sewer system beneath the city; its circuit ran under the [[Refugee Sector]], around the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr|methane bar]] and through the [[Nar Shaddaa Docks|docks]]. Some [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racers]] from other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] considered this track to be one of the most difficult due to the various obstacles and dangers facing a swoop racer.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'': Conversation with [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] swoop racer [[Jonra Far]].</ref>

One obstacle came from the fan blasts from the still-active sewer vents. These blasts of air were strong enough to throw a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] in the opposite direction from which the fans were blowing. Another hazard presented itself on account of the track running through the docks; on any given day there was the possibility of [[Forklift|heavy loaders]] obstructing the course while in the process of moving cargo. However, the greatest danger came from the fact that the track held mutiple races simultaneously. One swoop racing circuit owner, [[Lupo Shar]], took advantage of this and ran his races backwards. Subsequently, a swoop racer had to be alert for racers approaching from the opposite direction.
